name.text: Alternate Segment Theorem - two tangent-chord angles (INNODEMS)

questiontext.text:
In the figure, \(PTL\) is a tangent to the circle at \(T\), and \(TQ\) and \(TS\) are chords. The point \(S\) lies in the alternate segment. You are given that

\[ \angle PTQ = {@p@}^\circ \qquad\text{and}\qquad \angle LTS = {@q@}^\circ . \] [[jsxgraph width="470px" height="470px"]] var p = {#p#}; var q = {#q#}; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-3.4, 3.2, 3.4, -3.4], keepaspectratio: true, axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false }); var R = 2.5; var rad = Math.PI / 180; var aT = 270; // T at the bottom; tangent is horizontal var O = board.create('point', [0, 0], {visible: false, fixed: true}); board.create('circle', [O, R], {strokeColor: '#888', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); var T = board.create('point', [R * Math.cos(aT * rad), R * Math.sin(aT * rad)], {name: 'T', size: 3, fixed: true, fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeColor: '#1565c0', label: {offset: [0, -14], anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top'}}); var Q = board.create('point', [R * Math.cos((aT + 2 * p) * rad), R * Math.sin((aT + 2 * p) * rad)], {name: 'Q', size: 3, fixed: true, fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeColor: '#1565c0', label: {offset: [12, 2], anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle'}}); var S = board.create('point', [R * Math.cos((aT - 2 * q) * rad), R * Math.sin((aT - 2 * q) * rad)], {name: 'S', size: 3, fixed: true, fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeColor: '#1565c0', label: {offset: [-12, 2], anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'middle'}}); var Ty = R * Math.sin(aT * rad); var L = board.create('point', [-2.0, Ty], {name: 'L', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [-4, -12], anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'top'}}); var P = board.create('point', [2.0, Ty], {name: 'P', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [6, -2], anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle'}}); board.create('segment', [L, P], {strokeColor: '#333', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); (a) Find \( \alpha = \angle TSQ = \) [[input:ans1]]\(^\circ\) [[validation:ans1]]\(^\circ\) [[feedback:prt1]]
(b) Find \( \beta = \angle TQS = \) [[input:ans2]]\(^\circ\) [[validation:ans2]]\(^\circ\) [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
By the Alternate Segment Theorem, a tangent-chord angle equals the inscribed angle in the alternate segment (on the other side of that chord).

(a) For the chord \(TQ\), the tangent-chord angle is \( \angle PTQ = {@p@}^\circ \). Its alternate segment contains \(S\), so

\[ \alpha = \angle TSQ = \angle PTQ = {@p@}^\circ . \]

(b) For the chord \(TS\), the tangent-chord angle is \( \angle LTS = {@q@}^\circ \). Its alternate segment contains \(Q\), so

\[ \beta = \angle TQS = \angle LTS = {@q@}^\circ . \]

Check: the remaining angle of triangle \(TSQ\) is \( \angle STQ = 180^\circ - {@p@}^\circ - {@q@}^\circ = {@angT@}^\circ\), and along the straight tangent line at \(T\), \( \angle LTS + \angle STQ + \angle QTP = {@q@}^\circ + {@angT@}^\circ + {@p@}^\circ = 180^\circ\).
